_comment: Generic Socrates starter pack. A fresh install copies this into LIFEOS/USER/SOCRATES/questions/ via `socrates seed`, then edits it into their real questions. No personal data here — this file ships publicly.

questions.text: Do I have anything on the internet that is vulnerable?
questions.ideal: Zero open critical or high findings across the deployed surface.

questions.text: Do I have any keys or secrets exposed publicly?
questions.ideal: No exposed-secret or sensitive-file findings on any public surface.

questions.text: Do I have anything deployed that is not registered in the harness?
questions.ideal: Every serving domain has a curated security-plane target.

questions.text: What is my monthly burn, and is it where I expect?
questions.ideal: Burn is known, current, and under the stated ceiling.
ruled_out: the finance adapter's burn answerer reads an expenses ledger CLI that is not part of the public release; activate with an answerer once an expenses tool is installed

questions.text: Is any domain I own about to lapse?
questions.ideal: Every owned registration is more than 45 days from expiry.

questions.text: What developments in the next six months would blindside me?
questions.ideal: Standing horizon scan exists with a named answerer.
